integrity: The ACD criterion is derived directly from \(0^2=b^2=0\) and \(a^2=c^2=b\). Coordinate-permutation classes reduce exactly to four-symbol compositions, after which the distance-refined and total counts are finite sums. A standalone verifier exhaustively checks every vector through length \(7\) and reproduces the published cardinality-two counts through length \(5\).
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to cardinality-two additive codes over \(I_2\) and coordinate-permutation equivalence. It does not classify larger additive subgroups or equivalence under additional alphabet transformations. The source has a later correction; the proof here uses only the ring multiplication table and ACD definition, not the corrected theorem statements.
title: All-length classification of cardinality-two ACD codes over \(I_2\)
